backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor managing user profiles, stats, availability, logs, and authorization with helper modules and query functions.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing features, related files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of various frontend files used for reference in build planning.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining light and dark theme CSS variables and base styling.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point mounting the root element and loading the main React script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app with routing, authentication gate, global layout, and global toast provider.
frontend/src/components/auth/AccessDenie: Admin-only access denied screen with descriptive messaging and a return button.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginScreen: Login screen using Internet Identity with background image, branding, and sign-in button.
frontend/src/components/branding/AppLogo: Simple logo component rendering the app’s branded image.
frontend/src/components/chat/ChatPanel.t: Displays recent group chat messages with scroll handling and message sending using hooks.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Defines the main app layout with header, navigation, content area, and footer.
frontend/src/components/layout/Navigatio: Renders a navigation bar with route links and optional admin link based on user role.
frontend/src/components/layout/TopBar.ts: Shows the top bar with logo, theme toggle, user avatar menu, and logout handling.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileC: Lets users view and edit their profile name and picture with upload and validation logic.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileL: Displays the user’s leaderboard rank or a loading skeleton.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileM: Shows the user's match history with loading, empty, and error states.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileS: Modal prompting new users to enter and save their display name.
frontend/src/components/theme/Background: Provides a page wrapper with a faint fixed background image.
Displays a user avatar and name with fallback initials and sizing options.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches the backend actor based on identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserProfile: Provides hooks to load and save the caller’s user profile via the actor API.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserRole.ts: Provides hooks using react-query to fetch the caller's user role and admin status from the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity context/provider and hook for managing identity loading, login, logout, and status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines multiple react-query hooks for fetching and mutating user profiles, availability data, and match history through the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useTheme.ts: Manages light/dark theme state with localStorage persistence and HTML class updates.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserDirectory.ts: Provides hooks to fetch user directory info, including names and avatars, with graceful fallbacks.
frontend/src/index.css: Sets Tailwind base/styles and defines light and dark theme CSS variables for the app.
frontend/src/lib/branding.ts: Exports centralized branding constants such as app name and logo URLs.
frontend/src/lib/date.ts: Utility functions for converting between dates and day IDs, formatting dates/times, and generating calendar grids.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AddAvailabilityPage.t: Page component for adding or editing a user's availability with time selection, notes, and submission logic.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard listing users and daily availabilities with options to delete them and view directory data.
frontend/src/pages/CalendarMonthPage.tsx: Renders a month grid showing days with availability and navigation between months alongside a chat panel.
frontend/src/pages/ChatPage.tsx: Simple page displaying the group chat panel.
frontend/src/pages/DayDetailPage.tsx: Shows detailed availability for a specific day with options for the user to edit or delete their entry.
frontend/src/pages/LeaderboardPage.tsx: Displays leaderboard rankings with controls to record or remove wins and losses per available day.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Profile page showing user info, leaderboard rank, and recent match history.
frontend/src/utils/file.ts: Provides helpers to convert files to Uint8Array and extract initials from names.
frontend/src/utils/time.ts: Utility functions for formatting, parsing, and generating time selection components.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers for reading URL parameters (including hash routes) and persisting them in sessionStorage, plus utilities to clear stored or hash parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, container settings, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Defines the project’s state and feature requirements related to implementing in-app toast notifications for availability updates and leaderboard rank changes.
